appDescription.message: Extract clean DOM content for AI processing. Multiple output formats, configurable filters.

capturePickerTitle.message: Select an element on the page

captureSmartExtractTitle.message: Main content only (without nav, ads, footer)

profileDevTitle.message: Keep HTML structure, remove overhead only

profileRawTitle.message: Minimal filters, keep as much as possible

pickerInfoHint.message: Click to select -- ESC to cancel

donateDescription.message: Open source from Sachsen-Anhalt. No tracking, no ads, no compromises.

helpSubtitle.message: Prepare web content for AI processing

helpPickerDesc.message: Starts a visual element picker. Move the mouse over the page - a blue frame highlights the element under the cursor. Click to capture, ESC to cancel.

helpPickerIdeal.message: Ideal for: individual paragraphs, tables, sidebars, specific areas.

helpSelectionDesc.message: Captures currently selected text on the page. First select the desired area, then open the popup and click "Selection".

helpSelectionIdeal.message: Ideal for: exact text passages, quotes, individual paragraphs.

helpFullPageDesc.message: Captures the complete DOM of the current page - including all dynamically generated content (Single Page Apps, AJAX-loaded data, etc.). Configured filters are applied afterwards.

helpFullPageIdeal.message: Ideal for: complete page capture, dynamic web apps, pages with JavaScript-generated content.

helpSmartExtractDesc.message: Uses readability heuristics to automatically identify the main content. Systematically removes navigation, ads, footers, sidebars, cookie banners, and other non-content elements.

helpSmartExtractIdeal.message: Ideal for: news articles, blog posts, documentation pages.

helpProfileAIDesc.message: AI-Optimized - Markdown output, maximum cleanup. All filters active.

helpProfileDevDesc.message: Developer - HTML output, only JS removed. Structure fully preserved.

helpProfileRawDesc.message: Minimal - HTML output, no filters. The DOM as-is.

helpProfileCustomDesc.message: Custom - Automatically saves your manual settings. Click to restore.

helpFormatHTMLDesc.message: Cleaned HTML with structure. Tables, lists and headings preserved as tags.

helpFormatMDDesc.message: Tables become pipe tables, headings become # notation, lists become bullet points.

helpFormatTextDesc.message: Only visible text. Tables are output tab-separated.

helpFormatJSONDesc.message: Structured tree with tags and text. Tables extracted as arrays with header keys.

helpFilterJSDesc.message: Removes all script tags and event handler attributes. Almost always useful for AI processing.

helpFilterCSSDesc.message: Removes style tags, stylesheet links, inline styles and class attributes. Massively reduces output.

helpFilterSVGDesc.message: Removes inline SVG graphics and canvas elements.

helpFilterImagesDesc.message: When enabled: images are completely removed. When disabled (default): replaced with [IMG: alt-text] placeholders.

helpFilterDataDesc.message: Removes data-*, aria-* and role attributes. Unnecessary token overhead for AI processing.

helpFilterEmptyDesc.message: Iteratively removes HTML elements that contain neither text nor children after filtering.

helpFilterNavDesc.message: Removes navigation elements: nav tags, breadcrumbs, pagination, menus and sidebars.

helpFilterFormsDesc.message: Removes all form elements: form, input, select, textarea, button, fieldset and legend.

helpFilterFlattenDesc.message: Reduces nested wrapper elements. Saves significant tokens in HTML mode.

helpFilterDuplicatesDesc.message: Detects and removes identical text blocks appearing multiple times. Disabled by default.

helpFilterWhitespaceDesc.message: Replaces multiple spaces with single spaces, reduces excessive blank lines.

helpMaxCharsDesc.message: Limits output to a maximum character count. Default: 100,000,000 (practically unlimited).

helpPreviewDesc.message: Opens the result in a new tab. In HTML mode, switchable between rendered view and source code.

helpSnapshotsDesc.message: Each extraction is automatically saved as a snapshot (max. 10). Click to load, X to delete. Persists across browser restarts.

helpTip.message: Tip: For best AI preparation, use the "AI-Optimized" profile with Markdown format.
